spec.reason: Test whether the declared twelve-dimensional signal survives native layers, and whether explicit projections preserve it with less global disturbance than the earlier amplified attention map.
spec.readout: Cosine against the same thirteen original prototype centers, without refitting; descriptive question-type classification only.

weights.formula: Uniform block-21 heads 6/7; add alpha*U*B*Pmu to their original O columns. Protected condition additionally applies P=I-UUt to O21 and all later attention/MLP output projections, and W diag(g) P diag(g)^-1 to MLP21 and later attention/MLP input projections. RMS denominators remain native and may still change.
